also.quote: International Application Deadlines | Fall | Application | Document Submissions | May 1 | June 1

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Biology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact potential faculty advisors during the application process and submit a signed Graduate Advisor Acceptance Form; admission is contingent on faculty mentorship availability.

also.quote: Admission is contingent upon the availability of a faculty member willing to serve as the student's research director and program mentor.
1. Pre-admission faculty contact: Students must establish communication with potential advisors during the application process and have a signed Graduate Advisor Acceptance Form.

funding.value: Competitive teaching assistantships, research assistantships, and fellowships (providing stipend and tuition waiver) depend on availability; applicants should consult potential faculty advisors on funding prior to applying.
funding.quote: Depending on the program, students may be eligible for support as a teaching assistant, research assistant, or through a fellowship. ... These positions depend on availability and are competitive; potential graduate students should consult with individual faculty members about the availability of funding prior to applying.

entry_route.value: Baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution with minimum 3.0 GPA for highest degree earned (60 credits total; 7-year limit from BS or 6-year limit from MS).
entry_route.quote: 1. Applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree from an institution accredited by a recognized accrediting agency.

also.quote: by the end of the sixth year for students entering with an M.S. degree, or by the end of the seventh year for students entering with only a baccalaureate degree.

notes: Standalone Ph.D. in Integrative Biology (IBIO-PHD) in the Department of Biology. Biology also participates as a concentration in the Environmental Sciences Ph.D. (ENV-BIOL; GRE waived, 3.5 GPA, signed Graduate Advisor Acceptance Form and identified stipend/research support required). While the Graduate Catalog general procedures table lists GRE General for College of Arts and Sciences, the IBIO-PHD admission checklist omits GRE and its item 7 states TOEFL/IELTS is required unless the baccalaureate was earned from an accredited English-speaking university.
